scientific_integrity: Prior weighted spanning-tree enumeration credited; independent scientific validation not performed; finite matrix-tree replay supports but does not establish the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Known total vertex count and exact marginal degree law required; no finite-sample or general-graph reconstruction; classical weighted enumerator is not claimed as original; possible uncatalogued earlier inverse theorem.
title: One rooted spanning-tree degree law reconstructs every complete multipartite graph
